work_completed: Owner feedback 25/11 (device): the Lunet keyboard is removed (typing latency); typing is the system IME's; CodeBar: one row above it with Teclas (symbols, Tab, arrows; suggestions after a 120 ms pause), Atalhos (undo/redo/line operations/palette) and Métodos (catalog in the keyboard's place), plus a hide key.
Android Back: routed from AvaloniaActivity.BackRequested (it never reached the shell's TopLevel); Back closes bar/keyboard, panel/sheet, then the previous tab (tab history), then the game.
Home for the thumb: bottom navigation bar (Jogos, Aprender, Jogar, Studios, Mais), Novo jogo as a floating button, games as 72 dp rows on phones and a grid when wide, implausible dates hidden.
Routed previous screens no longer show their own launcher navigation; dialog routes (Biblioteca, Gerar APK, Ajustes) open over a plain background and closing the last dialog returns to the shell.

A6 Biblioteca in the shell (LibraryView over ReusableAssetLibrary, same FilesDir/Library): live search with pictures, asset page with Usar num jogo first, Nova versão, Exportar ZIP, Verificar; publish in three steps; imports never overwrite.
